foundry_calls.text: The carvings tell a burial rite in worn relief: a knight, an oath, and a sword broken across a knee.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

foundry_calls.text: The silence stretches. Far off, water drips a slow count, and the torch flame bends toward the northern archway — as if something there breathes.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage
